topic: Emojis Are Approved by a 12-Person Committee That Controls All Text on Earth
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Ever wonder who decides on new emojis? It's not a secret society, but a tiny, powerful committee!

Here’s the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Every emoji you use is approved by a small 12-person committee.
🔹 This committee is part of the Unicode Consortium, which standardizes ALL digital text, globally.
🔹 They review thousands of emoji proposals yearly to ensure global compatibility across all devices and platforms!
